purpose: Source-only MiiIcon manager/job and face-target orchestration evidence

policy.scope: manager jobs and faceline/MiiMask target callbacks only

request_queue.source_boundary: The queue preserves source-provided character and render fields. Request variant order is not evidence of final GameUber model/shape draw order.

request_to_job_model_record_routing.boundary: These are model render records receiving callbacks, not an ordered list of final Head/Hair/Nose/Ear/Beard/Body/outfit BFRES shape draws.

model_render_target_record_routing.boundary: These helpers prove target-handle registration and cleanup for each model render record. They do not serialize the final model draw list, bind GameUber runtime buffers, or establish final BFRES shape order.

manager_target_descriptors.note: Dimensions/formats are owned by the separate checked face-mask and title-execution ledgers.

remaining_hard_boundary.detail: The keyed request queue, manager state machine, and face-target callback routing are source-validated. Request variants 0/1/2 do not prove final draw order. Final Head/Hair/Nose/Ear/Beard/Body/outfit shape submission order, pass selection, render-target routing, and all unresolved GameUber runtime buffers/prepass samplers remain fail-closed.

functions.name: update_mii_actor_icon_render_requests
functions.evidence: Compares the live actor character/render payload against its cached records and upserts request variants 0, 1, and 2 only when their source fields change.

functions.name: query_actor_is_sleeping
functions.evidence: Resolves the actor identified by the source record and returns the live IsSleeping boolean; the result is copied into MiiIcon request variant 1 rather than supplied as a renderer default.

functions.name: compare_mii_icon_request_render_parameters
functions.evidence: Compares the source-backed 0x5c render-parameter block fields used to decide whether request variants 0 and 1 must be upserted; the untested word at +0x4c is not claimed as padding or data.

functions.name: upsert_mii_icon_render_request
functions.evidence: Under the manager lock, finds a request by render-handle ID and variant or allocates a 0x128-byte record, then copies the 0x98-byte character payload and source-provided render fields without inventing defaults.

functions.name: get_or_create_mii_icon_manager_singleton
functions.evidence: Allocates exactly 0x3b40 bytes, constructs the object, and stores it at DAT_71040eaa18.

functions.name: initialize_mii_icon_manager_core_state
functions.evidence: Initializes the 0x3b40 manager object before render-resource setup.

functions.name: initialize_mii_icon_manager_render_resources
functions.evidence: Binary-discovered constructor continuation registered under the exact MiiIconMgr name; allocates four 0x1010 jobs and initializes faceline/mask render resources.

functions.name: update_mii_icon_manager_render_jobs
functions.evidence: Iterates the four 0x1010 render jobs, advances their state, assigns queued requests, and resets completed jobs.

functions.name: advance_mii_icon_render_job_state
functions.evidence: Dispatches states 1 through 4 through the checked four-byte jump table and installs per-model face-target callbacks after readiness checks.

functions.name: reset_mii_icon_render_job
functions.evidence: Detaches installed callbacks, releases the resource request, clears child lists, and returns the job state to zero.

functions.name: assign_mii_icon_render_request_to_job
functions.evidence: Copies the request's model list and 0x98-byte character payload into an idle/completed job, then starts or resumes its resource request.

functions.name: start_mii_icon_model_resource_request
functions.evidence: Builds and submits the model-resource request stored at job+0xd50.

functions.name: synchronize_mii_icon_model_for_render_job
functions.evidence: Copies the job character payload into the resolved model state and prepares the model-side render callbacks.

functions.name: record_mii_icon_face_target_commands_callback
functions.evidence: Model callback records faceline commands from owner+0xd58 and MiiMask commands from owner+0xeb0 in that order.

functions.name: flush_mii_icon_face_target_constants_callback
functions.evidence: Model callback serializes/uploads faceline constants first and MiiMask sprite constants second.

functions.name: replace_model_render_record_target_handle
functions.evidence: Unregisters the model render record from its scheduler bucket, clears its existing target-handle list, validates the supplied two-word handle, and installs that one handle when valid.

functions.name: clear_model_render_record_target_handles
functions.evidence: Unregisters the model render record from its scheduler bucket and returns every target-handle node to the record's free list.

functions.name: serialize_mii_faceline_constant_buffers
functions.evidence: Serializes the seven faceline layer transform and color constant-buffer records when dirty.

functions.name: record_mii_faceline_texture_commands
functions.evidence: Records up to seven active faceline layer draws into the faceline render target.

globals.name: mii_icon_manager_singleton_reference
globals.evidence: ELF GOT slot contains addend 0x40eaa18 and is dereferenced by the manager update caller.

globals.name: mii_icon_manager_vtable
globals.evidence: Installed as the manager object's primary vtable by FUN_7101bc7590.

globals.name: mii_icon_face_target_command_callback_vtable
globals.evidence: Installed with owner and callback FUN_7101bcb028 in each model render record.

globals.name: mii_icon_face_target_constant_callback_vtable
globals.evidence: Installed with owner and callback FUN_7101bcb0d8 in each model render record.

globals.name: model_render_scheduler_bucket_table_reference
globals.evidence: Dereferenced by the checked model-record target helpers to select one of two scheduler buckets from record+0x414.

data_types.name: MiiIconManager
data_types.evidence: Exact registration string MiiIconMgr; singleton allocation size 0x3b40.

data_types.name: MiiIconRenderJob
data_types.evidence: Recovered incomplete layout; manager owns four contiguous 0x1010-byte records with state at +0 and model-list count/pointer at +8/+0x10.

data_types.name: MiiIconRenderRequest
data_types.evidence: Recovered incomplete request layout copied by FUN_7101bc9f50; includes model list and character/render settings payload.

data_types.name: MiiIconQueuedRenderRequest
data_types.evidence: Exact 0x128-byte manager queue record keyed by render-handle ID and request variant; payload fields through +0x114 and list node at +0x118 are copied by FUN_7101bc7160.

data_types.name: MiiIconRequestRenderParameters
data_types.evidence: Recovered incomplete 0x5c block compared by FUN_71019edff4 and copied into queued request payloads; the comparison intentionally does not classify the untested +0x4c word.

data_types.name: ModelRenderRecord
data_types.evidence: Recovered incomplete layout used by FUN_7101c696d0/FUN_7101c698a0, with scheduler selector +0x414, target-handle list count/capacity/storage/free-list at +0x518/+0x51c/+0x520/+0x528, and registration bit0 at +0xb9c.

data_types.name: MiiIconFaceTargetCallbacks
data_types.evidence: Two owner/function delegate records installed per resolved model for command recording and constant-buffer upload.
